Passages 000082922425000114#item7#passage-000001, -000002, -000005 and -000009 directly cover both. They report a 1% consolidated comparable store sales decline ($408M, driven by a 2% decline in comparable transactions) and a 2% North America comp decline. They also report net new company-operated store growth of 5% (1,010 stores) and 4% (441 stores) in North America over the past 12 months, plus the 627 and 584 restructuring closures. Gross opening counts are not stated, so the openings element rests on net store growth, keeping this at 4 rather than 5. The audit prompt's 2024 comparison is out of scope for this subquery.
